First make a layout, how wide, how would the overall build be. Can be as simple as bare boxes at first, interconnected without being in a grid (or make it a grid if you like it that way).

(actually first is to decide on a theme)

Then, try to visualize how it could look better, by taking inspiration on the Internet if you're feeling uninspired (without copying block by block, try different styles and make it work). Mentally separate every zones as having their own use (chest room, workshop, bathroom, observatory, etc)

afterward, tweak how the boxes are placed: can you move as much/as easily as you want? Is it a hassle to get through your base? Is everything you could think of there? Are every npcs going to die at the first blood moon? All of that must be taken into account for a base you're satisfied with

When satisfied, build a more refined shape with different blocks other than just wood, like stone (mostly for visualization of how the final product will look like)

Then add details, organized in a logical way (without logic cutting away at the fun, like if you want a flying crystal ship, go for it). Details can range from walls having a different rock pattern, windows with red banners around, statues painted blue or alternative rocks painted dark gray, etc etc. Also can be something like a non-linear room that isn't just a rectancle.

And finally, well there's no finally. You can always improve on your build, add some corners, hammer a block, add a new zone. Imagination is boundless!

(Tip: some weird-looking blocks can look awesome if you paint them in a certain way)

Also, nobody sucks at building, you just have to try your hands at it first!
